cases.question: What are the modeling requirements and behavior of the modified Riks method (*STATIC, RIKS) in Abaqus/Standard for tracing the equilibrium path with proportional loading beyond limit points, and what output (e.g. LPF) does it provide?
cases.observed_context: Abaqus/Standard nonlinear static equilibrium-path study; load spatial distribution is fixed and scaled by a single proportionality factor; ordinary load control fails near the limit point. This inspection task requests only a technical explanation.
cases.finding: The postbuckling hit changes from Material Options at rank 4 to The Riks Method > Incrementation at rank 3. The delivered 600-character excerpt now includes arc-length increment information. LPF and proportional-loading context remain, but the core Riks derivation and dead/reference-load qualifications are not fully delivered; this is not a complete answer pass.

cases.question: In a modified Riks analysis (*STATIC, RIKS) in Abaqus/Standard, can non-zero prescribed displacements be used as the (scaled) loading, or must the proportional loading be applied through force-type loads that are scaled by the load proportionality factor?
cases.observed_context: Abaqus/Standard nonlinear static equilibrium-path project using modified Riks (*STATIC, RIKS); technical inspection only, no model changes. Need the requirement for how proportional loading must be applied in the Riks step.
cases.finding: The same Loads passage moves from rank 3 to rank 2. Boundary Conditions is still absent. The source supports BC application and the restriction on varying BC magnitudes with amplitudes, not an unsupported blanket ban on all nonzero prescribed displacements.

cross_cutting_findings: Page/section metadata provenance is clearer, but no product hard filter was introduced. Two new warning hits visibly name Explicit in a dual-product page. Across the two warning queries, reviewed wrong-product hits increase from 1 to 3; shared-page labels alone would not exclude the two new ones.
AT false extraction is unchanged by design. It consumes rank 1 in both warning queries in both arms; this comparison does not isolate its causal contribution to the missing answer.

Longer heading paths also consume the existing 600-character excerpt budget. In the Riks Unstable Problems snippet the old excerpt includes the modified-Riks name while the new excerpt truncates before it; in the Loads snippet the Riks-specific ignored-amplitude sentence is cut earlier. Do not equate richer metadata with more delivered body evidence.
The Explicit Requesting Preselected Output hit is a heading-only record in both versions, exposing a separate content-quality problem left unchanged.
The old and new index builds have different HNSW graphs and chunk content. This is an index-version comparison, not a factorial experiment attributing ranking deltas to one metadata field.
decision: Preserve the new full index as a separate development artifact; do not switch the default index. Retain context provenance work, but do not claim overall retrieval improvement or Agent benefit from these five queries.
limits: Five observed queries from three development scenarios, not five independent held-out tasks.
BM25 was built and corpus-verified but not ranked in this active-tool comparison; no new Hybrid/BM25 benefit claim.
